text: Output wraps the diagram in a fenced code block tagged mermaid
Uses stateDiagram-v2 rather than a flowchart, matching the lifecycle nature of the problem
Marks the entry point with [*] transitioning into the requested state
Marks the terminal states (rejected, settled, abandoned) with transitions to [*]
Represents the failed-to-submitted retry transition and labels the 3-attempt limit
Includes the 30-day auto-expiry transition from requested to abandoned
Transitions carry labels naming the triggering event (approve, reject, webhook, resubmit, expire) rather than being unlabeled arrows
